root_cause.escaped_defect: Independent pull_request workflows, fetch-depth:0, stale candidate pressure and ambiguous supersession caused duplicate work and unstable delivery. An earlier candidate also inherited an unrelated full_assurance branch variant.
root_cause.evidence: PR #3911 demonstrated duplicate browser/page/quality/skill fanout; workflow logs fetched refs/heads/*; #3924 exposed cross-obligation supersession ambiguity; #3928 exposed the stale full_assurance variant against the canonical Netlify premerge contract.

prevention.ingress: Required remains the canonical PR admission/release gate; heavy browser, page/SEO, Quality Intelligence, Skill Projection and Business OS Migration no longer allocate independent PR runners.
prevention.fetch: Required and website classifiers use shallow checkout plus exact comparison-base fetch on demand.
prevention.provider: Supabase Preview applicability is owned by Required with database-relevant config.toml semantics preserved.
prevention.netlify: Current-main netlifyGovernanceExact behavior and unconditional netlify_build_required premerge ownership remain intact.
prevention.recovery: A five-minute watchdog redispatches only genuinely missing recent Required runs and preserves PR labels.
prevention.hygiene: The janitor closes explicit supersessions only inside the same Obligation-ID and separately closes generated candidates stale for more than 30 days.

evidence.observed_failure: duplicate PR fanout, complete remote ref fetches, ambiguous supersession and inherited non-canonical full_assurance logic
evidence.proof_boundary: canonical Required gate, exact base/head comparison, same-obligation janitor, bounded watchdog and current-main Netlify/Supabase semantics
